items.item: The header shows the delivery note number, issue date, source sales order or transfer number and dispatching warehouse, each with a visible label, and every date on the note uses one unambiguous format (such as 06 Nov 2026)
items.evidence: All four fields are present and labelled ('Số phiếu' PXK-2026-00482, 'Ngày lập' 07/11/2026, 'Theo đơn hàng số' DH-2026-04821, 'Kho xuất' Kho Bình Dương), but dates use ambiguous numeric DD/MM/YYYY form ('Ngày lập 07/11/2026', 'Ngày đặt hàng 05/11/2026') rather than an unambiguous format like '06 Nov 2026'.

items.item: Sender (company name, address, tax ID), recipient (customer name, delivery address, contact person and phone) and carrier (carrier name, vehicle plate or driver name) appear in three separately labelled blocks
items.evidence: Only two labelled party sections exist ('Bên giao hàng' and 'Khách hàng'); carrier data is not its own block but a single line inside the 'Địa chỉ giao hàng' box: 'Phương tiện giao hàng: Xe tải 1.5 tấn · Biển số 51C-123.45 · Tài xế Lê Văn Hùng · 0987 654 321', mixed with recipient delivery info under one heading.

items.item: The goods are in a real <table> with column headers in <thead>, giving per line: line number, item code, description, unit of measure, quantity ordered, quantity delivered and lot or serial number, with quantities right-aligned
items.evidence: table#goods-table has a <thead> with STT, Mã hàng, Tên hàng hóa, ĐVT, Số lượng, Ghi chú — only one quantity column (no separate ordered vs delivered) and no lot/serial number column; also the STT numeric column is left-aligned (flagged by audit.json 'numeric-align' violation).

items.item: A line delivered short of the ordered quantity states the outstanding amount in words (such as "Backorder: 4 pcs")
items.evidence: No ordered-vs-delivered comparison exists anywhere; each row has a single data-qty value (e.g. td data-qty="200">200) with no backorder/shortage text in any row.

items.item: A footer gives the total quantity delivered, the number of packages and the gross weight with its unit, and the quantity total equals the sum of the lines
items.evidence: tfoot shows 'Tổng cộng · 6 mặt hàng' and '435', and the script sums data-qty correctly (200+15+30+30+60+100=435), but there is no package count or gross weight figure anywhere on the page.

items.item: Signature boxes are provided for the warehouse keeper (issued by), the driver or carrier and the receiver, each with room for printed name, signature and date, plus a remarks area for the condition of the goods on receipt
items.evidence: The .sign-block grid has four columns ('Người lập phiếu', 'Thủ kho', 'Người giao hàng', 'Khách hàng nhận hàng'), each with '(Ký, ghi rõ họ tên)' and a 'Ngày ..... / ..... / 2026' line, but the only 'Ghi chú' box is pre-filled boilerplate text above the signatures, not a blank remarks field for goods condition at receipt.

items.item: A Print control that is a real <button> starts printing, and an @media print stylesheet hides the app navigation and on-screen controls, sets page margins and keeps the signature block from splitting across pages
items.evidence: <button type="button" onclick="window.print()" class="...bg-blue-700...">In phiếu</button>; @media print rule hides 'nav, header.app-header, .page-actions, .no-print'; @page { size: A4; margin: 14mm 12mm 16mm; }; '.sign-block { break-inside: avoid }' keeps signatures together.

items.item: The note's status (such as Draft, Dispatched, Delivered or Cancelled) is shown in words next to its number, and a draft or cancelled note prints with a visible "DRAFT" or "CANCELLED" mark
items.evidence: Status is shown as a hardcoded pill next to the title: 'Đã xuất kho', but there is no conditional logic, alternate status, or watermark/mark element anywhere in the markup or script for a draft/cancelled state.

items.item: A loading state is present, and a note that fails to load or does not exist shows a message with Retry and a link back to the delivery note list, never an empty template with blank fields
items.evidence: No loading skeleton/spinner and no error/retry/empty-state markup exist anywhere in the page; all content including the goods table is statically hardcoded with no fetch or error-handling script.

notes:
The 'VP' square next to the letterhead ('
VP
') functions as a company-logo placeholder but is built as an initials-avatar component typically used for a person. The 'Địa chỉ giao hàng' box (rounded-md border bg-slate-50) is nested inside the outer '.sheet' card (border shadow-sm), producing a card-in-card layout. Audit.json also flags real defects worth noting: numeric-align/tabular-nums failures on the STT column, a drop-shadow on the sheet card instead of border-only, and the document title using ALL-CAPS ('PHIẾU GIAO HÀNG (PHIẾU XUẤT KHO)').
